the dimensionally reduced expression of the QCD fermionic determinant at finite temperature, chemical potential and gauge field is a product of two factors, the first of which is a product of one dimensional determinants of differential operators with gauge field dependent coefficients and the second of which is an infinite product of one dimensional determinant expressions that are independent of the gauge field, the chemical potential and the temperature.
